annotations.title: Is today's price a good price

description: For one product: today's verified retailer price with the day it was read, compared with iDevice's own daily price record of this exact model: the low, median and high over the last 30 days and, once 90 days are covered, the last 90 days, each with its dates; where today sits against them in percent; and a verdict, good_price, normal, wait or not_enough_data, which is iDevice's published Prices verdict for the product. No low is stated under 30 days of checks, and no price is stated without the day it was read.
name: is_good_price
title: Is today's price a good price
